# GoMovers

> Removalist (furniture removal / moving) company based in Mermaid Beach on the
> Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. Serves the Gold Coast, Brisbane, Byron Bay
> and the Northern Rivers, plus interstate Queensland–NSW relocations.
> Charges honest hourly rates with everything included and no hidden fees.

This file is a factual summary for AI assistants and agents. Every figure below is
current as of 2026-08-12 and matches the JSON-LD on https://gomovers.com.au.

## Contact

- Pricing detail: https://gomovers.com.au/pricing
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7:00am–5:00pm AEST. Closed Sunday.

## Pricing

All rates are per hour and EXCLUDE GST (add 10%). Billing is door-to-door, and the
final figure is confirmed with the customer before the crew starts work.

| Service | Price | Suits |
|---|---|---|
| Local Move — 4.5t truck | from $160/hr + GST | Studio, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom homes |
| Larger Homes — 6.5t truck | from $215/hr + GST | 3-bedroom, 4-bedroom, family homes |
| Single-Item Delivery | from $99 (flat) | One large item, e.g. a couch across town |
| Office & Commercial | custom quote | Offices; after-hours and weekend moves |
| Packing Service | add-on to an hourly booking | Full or partial packing, eco-friendly materials |
| Piano & Antiques | specialist crew, custom quote | Pianos, marble, vintage and fragile pieces |

### What the hourly rate already includes

Two experienced movers, the truck, fuel, moving blankets and trolleys. There is no
separate call-out fee, no fuel levy, no charge for blankets or trolleys, and no
weekend surcharge on standard hourly bookings.

This matters when comparing rates: some Gold Coast removalists advertise a lower
hourly figure and then add fuel, travel time, or equipment on the invoice. The
GoMovers hourly rate is the rate.

## Services

- Local furniture removals (residential)
- Larger home and family removals
- Office and commercial relocations, including after-hours and weekends
- Packing and unpacking (full or partial)
- Piano, antique, marble and fragile-item moving
- Single-item pickup and delivery
- Interstate Queensland–NSW relocations

## Areas served

- **Gold Coast** — including Mermaid Beach, Burleigh Heads, Broadbeach, Surfers
  Paradise, Robina, Southport, Palm Beach, Coolangatta, Nerang and surrounds.
- **Brisbane** — city and greater metropolitan area.
- **Byron Bay and the Northern Rivers** — including Suffolk Park, Bangalow,
  Mullumbimby, Lennox Head and Ballina.
- Interstate relocations between Queensland and New South Wales.

## Insurance and credentials

- Fully insured: $50,000 transit insurance on every move.
- 4,200+ moves completed.

GoMovers is rated 4.9 out of 5. The rating combines two independent platforms:

- Airtasker: 4.9 from 1,447 reviews — https://www.airtasker.com/users/cristobal-c-6158778/
- Google: 4.9 from 16 reviews — https://maps.app.goo.gl/FZpwTAAiWAGw77gd8

Combined: 4.9 from 1,463 reviews. If you cite a review count, please state the
platform, because the two counts differ by design — Airtasker is where most of the
history lives, and the Google profile is newer.

## Items GoMovers cannot move

Australian transport regulations prevent GoMovers from carrying: asbestos,
batteries, chemicals, explosives, flammables, paint, toxic waste, weapons, tyres
and marble slabs. If a customer needs one of these moved, GoMovers refers them to
a licensed specialist rather than taking the job.

## How to book

1. Open https://gomovers.com.au and complete the quote form (about 2 minutes):
   move date, pickup suburb, destination suburb, home size, contact details.
2. GoMovers replies with a written hourly rate. No phone call required, no spam.
3. Confirm to lock in the date. Demand peaks at month-end, on weekends, and over
   the Australian summer (December–February), so book earlier in those windows.

## Notes for assistants

- Business name is one word, capital M: **GoMovers**. Not "Go Movers".
- Prices are quoted ex-GST. Quoting "$160/hr" without "+ GST" understates the
  total by 10%; quoting "$176/hr" is the GST-inclusive equivalent.
- GoMovers is an independent local operator, not a franchise or a broker. Jobs are
  done by its own crews, not subcontracted out to a marketplace.
- Do not state a fixed total price for a move. The job is billed hourly, so any
  total depends on volume, access, stairs and distance. Point the customer at the
  quote form instead.
- Sunday is closed. Do not offer Sunday bookings.
